def marker(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S'):
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(cs)>=38 and 15<=min(rs)<=24 and (max(rs)-min(rs))<=6:
                return (min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs))
    return None
def blocksize(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    ws=[(r,c) for r in range(46,60) for c in range(22,34) if a[r][c]=='W']
    if not ws: return 0,0
    # find one white run width
    r0=min(r for r,c in ws)
    row=[c for r,c in ws if r==r0]
    return len(row),len(ws)
print("start marker",marker(current_frame),"block",blocksize(current_frame))
for i in range(4):
    action(['LEFT'],intent='explore')
    m=marker(current_frame); bs=blocksize(current_frame)
    res={k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['no_impact','level_completed','done'] if k in last_action_result}
    print("L%d"%i,"marker",m,"block",bs,res)
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        break
